# Synthesis summary (generated by scripts/synth_summary.py)

Source: Yosys statistics in this directory. Software synthesis estimates only: no place-and-route, no timing analysis, no FPGA hardware. The iCE40 flow is a representative resource model, not a selected target device.

## Memory structures

- Data array: 16 block RAMs (one per byte lane, 16 lanes x 64 lines x 8 bit).
- Tag array: 2 block RAM(s) (64 lines x 22 bit).
- Valid bits: flip-flops (64), not RAM, because they must all clear on reset.
